en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup>
used to fobid from the walnuts to be eaten when the children used to come with these from the gambling, and said: ‘It is an ill-gotten gain’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan from al-‘Ala’ from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “One of the two Imam, (abu Ja’far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam, has said, ‘Gambling and plundering are not righteous deeds.’”
